note: Quiet William A. Switzer PP campground 19 km north of Hwy 16 on Hwy 40, then a few km of gravel; well-spaced sites surrounded by mature trees, with a cook shelter and playground. Jarvis Creek, a stocked trout pond, Graveyard Lake and Cache Lake are nearby. The hand pump has been out of service since August 4, 2025 (Alberta Parks advisory), so bring water. Firewood is sold at the Switzer Park Visitor Centre and the Gregg Lake booth, and the sani-dump is at Gregg Lake (fee). --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (Apr 24, 2026) + shop + tear sheet: C$30, May 14 - Sep 8, 14 unserviced reservable sites, vault toilets confirmed; hand pump unavailable since Aug 2025; the shop caps EVERY site at 20 ft of equipment (FIT DROP CANDIDATE); not waterfront confirmed; pin OK.
flags: FIT DROP CANDIDATE (curation: a site must fit a 23-ft rig; a posted equipment/trailer limit counts for a motorhome; ~20 ft = out): Alberta Parks' own booking engine (shop.albertaparks.ca, parkId 330112) lists all 14 Cache Lake sites (01-14) with 'Max Equipment Length (ft): 20' and 'Looking For Category: Overnight, RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site', although the pads are 28-67 ft long ('Site Length (ft)': 01 45, 02 46, 03 28, 04 52, 05 46, 06 42, 07 67, 08 30, 09 50, 10 58, 11 29, 12 42, 13 57, 14 56). It is not a park-wide default: in the same parkId Gregg Lake loops run 21-61 ft and Jarvis Lake 20-61 ft. The campground page itself says 'Well spaced sites are suitable for tents and RVs' and gives no length. Wording is the agency's (booking engine). Reviewer decides; wrote max_rig_ft 20 from the shop.
